meta.name: demo-with-narration
meta.description: Demos working software: first proves every claimed behavior by exercising the real artifact, then replays the proof as a slow, voice-narrated walkthrough. Use when the user asks for a demo or to be shown that something works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将软件功能验证变成语音讲解的演示
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要向他人证明软件功能正常工作
copy.tagline_en: Turn software behavior verification into a narrated walkthrough demo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prove your software works to others

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求演示时，Claude 会先私下运行实际软件，验证每个声称的行为；然后慢速回放，并用语音旁白逐步骤解释，证明软件确实能工作。
howto.when: 当用户提出演示请求，或要求证明某物能工作时触发。

say.note: Claude 会先私下测试，再旁白回放。

say.text: 给我一个带旁白的演示。
say.note: Claude 会以慢速、语音叙述的方式演示。

howto.what_en: When enabled, if the user asks for a demo, Claude first privately exercises the real artifact to verify every claimed behavior, then replays a slow, voice-narrated walkthrough that proves the software works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a demo or asks to be shown that something works.

say_en.note: Claude will run the demo process.
Claude will replay with slow voice narration.
